name: Screen with European Figures (obverse) and Landscape (reverse) with Stand
material: painted enamel, glass painting, and cast-iron stand
dimensions: Painting only: 35.7 x 32.4 cm (14 1/16 x 12 3/4 in.); height with stand: 65.8 cm (25 7/8 in.); screen only: 44.3 x 47.6 x 1.5 cm (17 7/16 x 18 3/4 x 9/16 in.)
summary: On the obverse side of this two-sided table screen is an enamel-painted copper plaque with European figures. The image is probably derived from prints.
